_comment: Copy this file to export_v3_private.json (gitignored - never commit it) and fill in the REAL paths for the machine export_v3_public.py is run on. Every value below is a placeholder, safe to commit.
src_apps_root: <path to the folder that holds every app's own git checkout>
src_data_root: <path to the folder used for work-copy logs, locks and test-DB slot bookkeeping>
src_backups_root: <path to the folder used for pre-migration pg_dump backups>
src_deploy_state_root: <path to the folder used for deploy locks and review-gate state>
src_admin_env: <path to an env file whose DATABASE_URL is a postgres role allowed to create/drop test databases>
src_unit_prefix: <systemd service-name prefix this host's apps use, e.g. myapp>
src_ops_dirname: <folder name under src_apps_root that holds this workspace's own ops/harness files - plans, a daily-review tool, test-trust checks; e.g. _ops>
src_archive_root: <path to the folder stale/garbage-collected work copies are moved to instead of deleted>
src_example_subfolder_app: <optional: the real app name this host's wt-new.sh/wt-land.sh/deploy.sh comments use as a worked example for an app whose project root is a subfolder, e.g. 'web/'; omit if none>
